node.title: L1 mixed residual: root-pinning/B11/rich-fiber intersection pin
node.statement: For one maximal-sunflower chart at the L1 lower cutoff, put p=sum_i min(|S_i|,ell-|S_i|), e=max(0,2d+1-h), G_2=v_(1)+v_(2), and G_R=(ell-r)+v_(1). For every fixed E_root,E_d,V_2,V_R, the union {p+e<=E_root} union {d<=ell+E_d and (G_2<=V_2 or G_R<=V_R)} is polynomially bounded. Hence the exact unpaid residual satisfies p+e>E_root and [d>ell+E_d or (G_2>V_2 and G_R>V_R)], while retaining the proved Omega(n/log^2 n) source-coupled rich fiber. More simply, every fixed (p,d-ell) box is paid, so the aggregate residual has p unbounded or d-ell unbounded. Inside the fixed first source, the anchored triple-polarity closure pays every fixed layout/core-defect/petal-polarity degree-ell common-pencil box across partial-core charts and all numerator/Forney fibers. Its internal residual is growing triple polarity, unanchored or smaller-fiber quotient maps, and arbitrary petal locators outside one common pencil. This is a strict residual pin, not a count of either escape branch.
